about: Public projects that use, ship or build on HIDMaestro, each checked against its own source, README or site. Projects with home true appear on the product page in this order. tools/build_adopters.py writes that list into index.html and tools/build_specs.py writes the full list into specs.html.
rest: Phone gamepads, sim-racing rigs, CAD input, keyboards and test tools
